about.heading: Practical AI for businesses that want to work smarter.
about.lead: Ostendic helps businesses automate repetitive work, integrate intelligent AI systems, and build smarter digital experiences.
body: We design and build workflow automations and custom AI agents that take routine work off your team, help you decide where AI genuinely fits, and develop professional websites that make it easy for customers to get in touch.
Ostendic is founder-led and small by design. Every project is scoped in writing, built with care and handed over in a form your team can run.
about.approachHeading: Four things we hold to on every project

approach.title: Start with the business problem
approach.text: Before choosing a platform, a design direction or an AI tool, we want to understand what isn’t working and what a good result would look like for you.

approach.title: Say what it costs before starting
approach.text: Every piece of work is scoped and priced in writing before it begins, including what is not included.

approach.title: Build what you can keep running
approach.text: We choose platforms and tools your team can live with after launch, and hand over what you need to manage them.

approach.title: Keep people in the loop
approach.text: In AI workflows, routine steps can be automated. Decisions that need judgement stay with a person.

privacy: We collect only what you send through the enquiry form on this site: your name, email address, and, if you choose to give them, your phone number, business name, budget range, the service you’re interested in and your project description.
We use those details for one purpose: to reply to your enquiry and, if we work together, to scope and deliver the work. We don’t sell them, and we don’t add you to a marketing list.
Enquiries are stored in our database for as long as we reasonably need them for an ongoing or possible engagement. Ask us to delete yours and we will.
For anything about your data, email harsh@ostendic.com.
terms: This site is provided for information. Content may change without notice, and nothing on it is an offer or a contract.
